notes: The API is operational, but the entry is outdated. The official site moved to nagerholidays.com and now documents v4. The old domain and v3-style example are not the current canonical interface. Official sources state that CORS is enabled and queries have no rate limit. The API uses bare unauthenticated GET requests, but the official terms do not define a formal free pricing tier.
